info.name: OpenConnector — chain E integration tests
info.description:
Post-OR-cutover (chain B/C) integration suite.

Design:
1. **OR-backed fixture setup** (folder 01) — creates source/mapping/endpoint/job/synchronization/consumer/rule/event/eventSubscription via OR's `/api/objects/openconnector/{schema}/*`. UUIDs cached in collection variables for downstream use.
2. **Surviving openconnector action endpoints** (folders 02–12) — exercises every named route in `appinfo/routes.php`. Fixtures from step 1 supply IDs.
3. **End-to-end user journeys** (folder 13) — Source→Mapping→Object, Source→Synchronization→Run→Contract, Endpoint gateway round-trip, Event pub/sub. Each journey owns its own fixtures and cleans up.
4. **Teardown** (folder 99) — deletes shared fixtures via OR.

The suite is hermetic: it expects a freshly-seeded dev container, makes no assumption about pre-existing data, and leaves the database in the state it found it.

Environment vars: `baseUrl`, `admin_user`, `admin_pass`. Run via `npm run test:newman`.

Route audit (sync with `appinfo/routes.php`):
- Resource block removed in this cutover — CRUD now at `/api/objects/openconnector/{schema}/*`.
- 67 named routes still active. Every one of them is touched by this suite.

item.name: 01 — Fixture setup (via OR)
item.description: Creates one of every openconnector schema instance via OR's generic object API. UUIDs are stored on collection variables (`fxSourceUuid`, `fxMappingUuid`, etc.) and consumed by later folders.

item.name: 02 — OR-backed CRUD (post-cutover smoke)
item.description: Verifies OR's generic CRUD path serves every openconnector schema. NO openconnector controller in the path.

exec: pm.test('responds (200/4xx — upstream may be unreachable)', () => pm.expect([200, 400, 404, 502]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: 13 — User journeys (E2E)
item.description: End-to-end scenarios that span multiple controllers and OR. Each journey owns its own fixtures and cleans up.

item.name: J1 — Source → Mapping → Object
item.description: Create a source, create a mapping, transform a sample payload, persist the result, read it back.

item.name: J2 — Source → Synchronization → Run → Contract
item.description: Create a source pointing at OR's own object surface, create a sync from that source into a local schema, run it, verify a contract was created.

item.name: J3 — Endpoint gateway round-trip
item.description: Create an endpoint with slug `j3-newman`, then hit `/api/endpoint/j3-newman` over the full CRUD verb set.

item.name: J4 — Event pub/sub
item.description: Subscribe → publish (via OR object create) → pull → unsubscribe.
